title: Show recent docs and apps when searching app dashboard
line: Application Dashboard now opens on a Dashboard view that shows favorites, recent applications, recent files and folders together.
explanation: Application Dashboard always opened on its first category, Recent Applications, so recent documents were only reachable through search or the separate Recent Files category, and the rest of the start page stayed empty. Christoph Wolk's draft MRs plasma-workspace!6794 and plasma-desktop!3845 add a DashboardModel combining favorite and recent applications, files and folders plus new apps, and a Dashboard start view using it in Application Dashboard and Kickoff. Both are applied here unchanged except one line: the favorite badge binding in Kicker's ItemGridDelegate used Kickoff's 'item' id instead of 'root', so it failed and the star badge showed on every item.

commits.message:
applets/kicker: add DashboardModel

The launchers' start pages only offer one kind of recent item at a time,
so recent documents never show up next to recent applications. Add a
model that combines favorites, recent apps, files and folders, and new apps.

BUG: 360389

applets/kicker, applets/kickoff: use DashboardModel

Application Dashboard opened on Recent Applications only, so recent
documents were only reachable through search or their own category. Add a
Dashboard start view with favorites, recent apps, files and folders.

BUG: 360389

media.caption: Master: Application Dashboard opens on Recent Applications only, no recent files on the start page
With the MRs: new Dashboard category opens first, with Applications (favorites starred, then recent), Files and Folders sections
Search still replaces the view with results as before
Kickoff also gets the Dashboard view as its first tab (part of the same MRs)
